rows.text: Isshin doubles every attack trigger you control, and this deck is built out of nothing else. Hero of Bladehold makes four Soldiers instead of two. Adeline makes two tokens per opponent instead of one. Hellrider deals two damage per attacker. Aurelia gives you TWO extra combat phases. The whole deck is one line — attack — and Isshin makes that line twice as good.

rows.name: Isshin, Two Heavens as One
rows.text: if a creature ATTACKING causes a triggered ability of a permanent you control to trigger, that ability triggers again. Read every "whenever this attacks" and "whenever you attack" in the deck as happening twice.

Note it doubles triggers from permanents YOU control caused by attacking creatures. That includes enchantments and equipment, not just the creatures themselves — Mardu Ascendancy, Curse of Opulence and Blade of Selves all double.

rows.name: Hero of Bladehold
rows.text: four 1/1 Soldiers per attack, and battle cry twice for +2/+0 on the whole team.

rows.name: Adeline, Resplendent Cathar
rows.text: two tokens per opponent per attack. In a four-player pod that is six bodies, and her own power counts them all.

rows.name: Hanweir Garrison
rows.text: four attacking Humans every combat, off a three-drop.

rows.name: Anim Pakal, Thousandth Moon
rows.text: two counters and two batches of Gnomes per attack. It snowballs faster than anything else in the deck.

rows.name: Krenko, Tin Street Kingpin
rows.text: two counters and two batches of Goblins, and the batches are sized after the counters land.

rows.name: Myrel, Shield of Argive
rows.text: doubles your Soldier count twice per attack, and opponents cannot interact on your turn at all.

rows.name: Ainok Strike Leader
rows.text: two Goblins per opponent whenever it or your commander attacks, and it sacrifices to make your tokens indestructible through a wrath.

rows.name: Mardu Ascendancy
rows.text: two Goblins for every nontoken attacker.

rows.name: Blade of Selves
rows.text: myriad twice — two token copies of the equipped creature attacking each other opponent.

rows.name: Aurelia, the Warleader
rows.text: her attack trigger doubles, so you untap and get TWO additional combat phases. Three combats in one turn, each one re-triggering every token maker above.

rows.name: Combat Celebrant
rows.text: exert it and the trigger doubles, untapping the team twice and adding two more combats.

rows.name: Neyali, Suns' Vanguard
rows.text: attacking tokens have double strike, and every token attack exiles a card you may play. With six tokens attacking that is six cards.

rows.name: Hellrider
rows.text: one damage per attacking creature, doubled — so two per attacker, before combat damage. On a board of ten attackers that is twenty damage from the trigger alone.

rows.name: Brutal Hordechief
rows.text: one life drained per attacker, doubled, and it can force their creatures to block where you choose.

rows.name: Mishra, Claimed by Gix
rows.text: each opponent loses life equal to your attacker count, twice.

rows.name: Tectonic Giant
rows.text: three damage to each opponent, twice, every attack — and again whenever an opponent targets it.

rows.name: Adriana, Captain of the Guard
rows.text: melee for the whole team. Attacking three players is +3/+3 on every creature, and Isshin doubles each melee instance.

rows.name: Iroas, God of Victory
rows.text: menace for the team and no damage to your attackers at all. Attacking becomes completely free.

rows.name: Dolmen Gate
rows.text: the same protection on a two-mana artifact.

rows.name: Akroma's Will
rows.text: with your commander out, take both halves. On a board of twenty tokens it is simply lethal.

rows.name: Boros Charm
rows.text: double strike on the one creature that needs it, or indestructible for the board through a wrath.

rows.name: Cathars' Crusade
rows.text: a counter on every creature for every creature that enters. With Adeline and Hero of Bladehold making six tokens a combat, the board grows by dozens of counters per attack.

rows.name: Goldnight Commander
rows.text: +1/+1 to the team for each creature that enters. Same trigger count, immediate damage instead of permanent counters.

rows.name: Elenda, the Dusk Rose
rows.text: grows on every death and leaves a pile of lifelinking Vampires behind.

rows.name: Bitterblossom
rows.text: a free flier every turn, which is another attacker for every "whenever you attack" trigger.

rows.name: Chivalric Alliance
rows.text: a card whenever you attack with two or more creatures — doubled to two.

rows.name: Firemane Commando
rows.text: the same, plus it taxes the rest of the table for attacking anyone but you.

rows.name: Neyali, Suns' Vanguard
rows.text: impulse draw scaling with your token count.

rows.name: Curse of Opulence
rows.text: a Gold token whenever the enchanted player is attacked, doubled — and the rest of the table gets one too, which points their attacks away from you.

rows.name: Skullclamp
rows.text: on 1/1 tokens, two cards each. This deck makes more 1/1s than any clamp can keep up with.

rows.name: Midnight Reaper
rows.text: a card for every nontoken creature that dies.

rows.name: Bastion of Remembrance
rows.text: a drain for every creature that dies, and this deck loses a lot of tokens in combat.

rows.name: Necropotence
rows.text: as much card advantage as your life total allows.

rows.name: Phyrexian Arena
rows.text: a card every turn.

rows.name: Night's Whisper
rows.text: two cards for two mana.

rows.name: Smothering Tithe
rows.text: Treasures to deploy two threats a turn.

rows.name: Swords to Plowshares
rows.text: one mana, exile.

rows.name: Path to Exile
rows.text: the second copy.

rows.name: Anguished Unmaking
rows.text: instant-speed exile for any nonland permanent.

rows.name: Bedevil
rows.text: artifact, creature or planeswalker, at instant speed.

rows.name: Generous Gift
rows.text: anything at all.

rows.name: Council's Judgment
rows.text: gets around hexproof and indestructible entirely, and usually exiles more than one thing.

rows.name: Chaos Warp
rows.text: the answer to an enchantment.

rows.name: Blasphemous Act
rows.text: cheap, and this deck rebuilds a board faster than anyone else at the table.

rows.name: Flawless Maneuver
rows.text: free with your commander out.

rows.name: Teferi's Protection
rows.text: phase out through a wrath, a combo kill or a huge attack.

rows.name: Deflecting Swat
rows.text: free, and it redirects the removal aimed at Isshin or at Aurelia.

rows.name: Sun Titan
rows.text: returns Skullclamp, Bitterblossom, a Signet or a dead three-drop on entry AND on every attack — doubled, so two permanents per attack.

guide.title: What to keep in an opening hand

rows.text: Keep two mana rocks or a rock and a cheap attacker. Isshin costs three and does nothing alone; the deck wants him down on turn three with a token maker following on turn four.

Sequence the attack triggers deliberately. Cathars' Crusade counters resolve as tokens enter, so making tokens BEFORE the pump triggers resolve means more counters — with Adeline and Hero of Bladehold, order the token makers first.

rows.name: Isshin, Two Heavens as One
rows.text: he is worth a removal spell to the table, so hold Flawless Maneuver or Deflecting Swat when you can. Losing him halves every card in your hand.

rows.name: Aurelia, the Warleader
rows.text: do not cast her into an empty board. She is a three-combat turn with a wide team and a 3/4 flier without one.
